hints.title: Digit Length Interval Counting
hints.text: Group numbers by their digit length: 1 to 9 has 9 digits, 10 to 99 has 90 * 2 = 180 digits, 100 to 999 has 900 * 3 = 2700 digits.

hints.title: Target Number Identification
hints.text: Subtract digit block counts from n until n falls into the current length block. The target number is start + (n - 1) // length.

hints.title: Positional Digit Extraction
hints.text: The specific character within target number corresponds to index (n - 1) % length. Convert the character to its integer value.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def findNthDigit(self, n: int) -> int:
        length = 1
        count = 9
        start = 1
        while n > length * count:
            n -= length * count
            length += 1
            count *= 10
            start *= 10
        start += (n - 1) // length
        return int(str(start)[(n - 1) % length])
```

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(log N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating characters or counting sequentially takes O(N) operations, which times out when N = 2^31 - 1.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Interval grouping skips entire powers of 10 in at most 10 iterations with O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle zero-based index math ((n - 1) // length) accurately to avoid off-by-one errors.
